title: Snapshot record
description: The request record kept beside retained response bytes. Not a contract document: it is hashed as a file, never canonicalized, and it contains JSON numbers the venue's API requires.

endpoint.description: The two info endpoints this system will call. An enum, not a base plus a path: an arbitrary URL must stay impossible, and a record naming one would be evidence of a request nothing here can make.

network.description: Which network the endpoint belongs to, stated so retained evidence cannot be mistaken for the other one. Optional: the 50 records at 085ccfb predate it and are all mainnet.

$comment: Frozen as schema v1 at T1's gate (PLAN.md section 7), after the contract met live data on 18 and 19 September. Uses the keyword subset implemented by tools/validate.py; an unknown keyword is an error there, never ignored. Every change since 062a245 is listed in schema/CHANGES.md with the case that forced it; a change after the freeze needs a new schema_version and a row there.
